notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.notes:
-Added GPU instancing, greatly improved rendering performance
-Updated and reworked variety of models
-Improved alpha transparencies for models
-Added Fullscreen hotkey (F11)
-Added Debug hotkey (F9)
-Added Movement Speed hotkeys (Numpad +/-)
-Added additional mouse/move speed values
-Removed AABB Frustum Culling in favor of instancing
-Removed fog, previously used to improve performance based on render distance
